rationale: Builds directly on the current winner and folds in the strongest recent architectural near-miss instead of repeating another EMA-only tweak. This switches decoder blocks to the earlier shared-norm parallel residual path while preserving the winning bigram tail, quant-aware endgame, and expanded float-kept EMA. The change costs essentially no artifact bytes, slightly trims decoder normalization work, and may let the late-stage EMA/roundtrip stack exploit the decoder more effectively under the 600-second wallclock.
title: Decoder Parallel Residual On Tail-EMA Bigram Best
